chapter: After the Paradise: club dates and Virginia
title: Timmy Rogers's show act, Buck and Austin Powell
summary: After a year and a half at the Bamboo he joined comedian Timmy Rogers's show act with Buck of Buck and Bubbles and Austin Powell, learning stagecraft before a Florida booking.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: dance team and comedy, for years, you know. So I went down town to the Bamboo and staid there for about a year and a half and then...
Who was in the band down there?

Horace Silvers (sic) and John Acee and Kelly Martin, at different times, and Kalil. It was a trio, no bass. And so I got tired of that and so Timmy says, "Come on." So then he showed me another new world, "the boards", they call 'em, the stage. And we rehearsed and then we went out on the road and I think our first job was in Cafe Society, together. And Buck of Buck and Bubbles was in the band and Austin Powell. I saw him today, you know, the guy that came up to the West End and sang "I Miss You So". He used to be in the "Cats and Fiddles". And we had two and "Jumpin' George" on drums and...I can't remember the bass player's name, but he passed on. But anyway, it was like a show act. And that's when I became aware of the stage. And I stayed with him. And Buck of Buck and Bubbles , he was somethin'

else. He played trumpet too. He could dance, play the piano. He was somethin'. He used to wake me up in the mornin' and play Louis Armstrong's solos note for note on the telephone at eight o'clock in the mornin'. I'm tellin' you, he was somethin'. But I worked with Timmy and I learned stage craft and we worked pretty good. We got down to Florida--and we were a little ahead of our time, just a little bit-- 'cause he had everything. But we got down to Florida and the Trenier Twins were the stars of the show. And they were the favorites; they go down there every year. So they tell us to go on and stay a half an hour and then let the Trenier Twins do their thing. But Timmy wanted to stay out there an hour and that made everybody mad. So we staid there eight weeks and the job was over and everybody was disgusted and everything, so...I'll never forget, I just bought a Chrysler Imperial and I drove all the way to Florida, 1400 miles for this job. But anyway, they let us go and...
